verdict.rationale: VPM advertises a "Real U.S. street address" and includes a free registered agent for LLC filings. Its TruLease tier adds a physical office address backed by a one-year lease and an optional utility bill, explicitly for financial-account compliance. VPM itself says the basic virtual mailbox address does not work for opening bank accounts, so bank KYC requires the pricier TruLease or TruResidence tier. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that banks and states accept the address, explicit evidence for vendor-form acceptance, and bank-KYC coverage on the base mailbox plan.
